steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Configure the core Android project settings using Gradle 8.5, target SDK 34, and compile SDK 34.

steps.title: Configure Manifest Permissions
steps.description: Add required internet access, foreground service permissions, and foreground service special use annotations inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create Modern Card Background Drawables
steps.description: Define standard custom shape layout drawables with rounded corners and light outlines to match native Material light styles.

steps.title: Create Custom Interaction Button Styles
steps.description: Design custom shape drawables for action and control buttons (Start/Stop/Copy/Open) to deliver a polished flat UI interface.

steps.title: Design Activity UI Layout
steps.description: Create the main screen UI containing input widgets for ports, connectivity state cards, setup controllers, and an integrated dark terminal log console.

steps.title: Implement Local Server Connectivity Checker
steps.description: Develop thread-isolated socket verification algorithms to test port 127.0.0.1 connectivity prior to tunnel initiation.

steps.title: Define Architecture-Specific Binary Setup Utility
steps.description: Build an execution-safe helper to parse platform architectures (ARM64, ARM, AMD64) and connect to official cloudflared release assets.

steps.title: Create Tunnel Service Core
steps.description: Establish standard Foreground Service structure with customized states and lifecycle triggers to handle native command execution in the background.

steps.title: Set Up Foreground Notification Channel
steps.description: Configure the Oreo-compatible Android Notification Channel and persistent service alerts with integrated tunnel actions for Stop operations.

steps.title: Implement Native Process Execution Controller
steps.description: Configure ProcessBuilder pipeline and reader loops to execute local binaries and dynamically extract trycloudflare URLs from live log streams.

steps.title: Develop Intent Broadcast Handlers
steps.description: Add dynamic status and terminal log broadcast receivers to maintain synchronized, responsive layout states in the Activity.

steps.title: Implement Security Safeguards and Permission Inquiries
steps.description: Incorporate run-time Android 13+ Notification requests and execute binary compatibility warning messages for Android 10+ file execution constraints.

steps.title: Integrate Native Action Controllers
steps.description: Configure clipboard copy tools and external system browser redirect actions for live web validation.

steps.title: Enable Settings Persistence
steps.description: Store selected port adjustments in SharedPreferences databases to support instant context recovery upon application restarts.

steps.title: Building Local Server Tunnel
steps.description: Compile the entire Android project, generating a deployable APK via Gradle build operations.
